description: React component file defining error message components for admin console team and channel settings in Mattermost, including errors for missing groups, domains, and users to be removed.

methods.name: NeedGroupsError
methods.description: Displays an error message if no groups are added for team or channel management, with optional warning styling.

methods.name: NeedDomainsError
methods.description: Displays an error message prompting to specify allowed email domains.

methods.name: UsersWillBeRemovedError
methods.description: Displays an error about users to be removed from team or channel, with a button to view the users.
